title: Isaiah
author: Isaiah son of Amoz.
date: Eighth century B.C., with ministry spanning kings of Judah.
audience: Judah and Jerusalem, with a message reaching all nations.
historicalSetting: Isaiah proclaims judgment, comfort, holiness, the Servant of the Lord, and future glory.
keyVerse: Isaiah 53:5 — "But he was pierced for our transgressions."
christFocus: Isaiah powerfully points to Christ through Immanuel, the promised King, and the suffering Servant who bears sin and brings salvation.
